name: Mateo Vargas Castillo
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on simulation and modeling. After graduating, he gained experience in a small sim racing company, honing his skills in creating realistic and immersive racing environments. Mateo is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of simulator technology, constantly seeking new ways to improve driver training and vehicle development. He is known for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to quickly adapt to new challenges.

At Target Racing, Mateo plays a pivotal role in optimizing the simulator for driver feedback and car setup development. He is meticulous in ensuring the accuracy of the simulated environment, striving to replicate real-world conditions as closely as possible. He believes that a well-calibrated simulator is crucial for driver confidence and performance, allowing them to push their limits without the risks associated with on-track testing. Mateo is committed to providing the team with the best possible simulation tools to achieve their competitive goals.
